figures/dataset_protocols.pdf.mm_selection_rule: first s = 0, 1, 2, ... with SeedSequence([20260930, s]) such that both initial velocity components are >= 1.2 px/frame, the first x-changed and first y-changed of 16 future draws each change velocity by >= 1 px/frame, and all nine digit centres of both futures lie in [9, 55] (digit fully visible)
figures/dataset_protocols.pdf.mm_split: training identity (illustration only; not an evaluation example)

figures/model_information_flow.pdf.note: reviewed Figma vector export; retained by the asset generator; no data

figures/moving_mnist_interval_coverage.p.question: Do stochastic forecasts carry useful spread?

figures/moving_mnist_paired_comparisons..note: single common scale; circles are matched-run differences; diamond and horizontal interval summarize each contrast; zero denotes equal scores
figures/moving_mnist_paired_comparisons..question: How does Shared-Var compare with Shared-Det and AdaSSL reference on Moving-MNIST?

figures/moving_mnist_representation_trad.note: left/right of each role: first/second series; within series replications 1-5 left to right

figures/moving_mnist_representation_trad.question: Do forecasting gains coincide with better representations?

figures/moving_mnist_sampling_control.pd.note: training identical within each pair; five lines per panel, one per replication; identities are in the plot-data CSV
figures/moving_mnist_sampling_control.pd.question: Does sampling the prior improve on its mean in the same trained model?

figures/moving_mnist_speed_strata.pdf.note: strata by initial speed |v| of the source state; counts are identical fixed-bank query counts
figures/moving_mnist_speed_strata.pdf.question: Where does the S1-S0 gain arise? (post hoc, secondary)

figures/mpi3d_forecast_failure.pdf.inclusion: all 20 MPI3D runs; all 2,048 queries have a defined (non-degenerate) gap

figures/mpi3d_forecast_failure.pdf.question: Is the MPI3D problem only the physical decoder?

figures/paired_physical_effects.pdf.note: squares are replications 1-5 left to right; diamond and bar: mean and interval; no significance marks
figures/paired_physical_effects.pdf.question: Primary paired contrasts

figures/physical_forecast_results.pdf.baselines: MM pixel constant velocity and simulator oracle; MPI3D privileged coordinate persistence and two-outcome oracle; each one fixed-bank calculation
figures/physical_forecast_results.pdf.question: How do the four roles compare on the primary metric?

figures/readout_fidelity.pdf.note: aggregate statistics only; no invented histograms
figures/readout_fidelity.pdf.question: How faithfully does each fitted readout decode real target features?

figures/residual_usage.pdf.inclusion: R1 and S1, five runs each; numbers next to points are replication IDs

figures/residual_usage.pdf.question: Is the Gaussian residual used at the end of training?

figures/training_cost.pdf.normalization: each quantity divided by the R1 value of the same dataset
figures/training_cost.pdf.question: What does Shared-Var (S1) cost relative to AdaSSL reference (R1) and Shared-Det (S0)?
